title: A clear decision meets uncertain feelings
meaning: Actions revised in pursuit of proportion can be accompanied by an anxious or ambiguous emotional response that remains distinct from established facts.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field describes revising shared actions when conditions change. Justice in energy connects effort with proportionate distribution and consideration of consequences for both people. The Moon in emotions brings ambiguity of impressions: even a well-supported decision may leave unease or images of events that have not happened. The overall tone therefore need not become calm immediately after an outward agreement has received a clear and reasonable form.

For example, you move a shared activity to make travelling easier for both people and divide the additional costs equally. Everything seems clear in words, yet a brief message from the other person raises a doubt: are they really pleased? **We have an agreement, while my anxious interpretation remains an interpretation.** The emotional uncertainty concerns the meaning of the response, although the time, place and costs have already been established.

A difficulty intensifies if an uncertain impression is used as evidence of unfairness. This can lead to another revision of the terms without addressing the source of unease. The opposite is also possible: the reasonableness of the calculation is used to rule out all doubt. The Moon does not confirm another person’s hidden dissatisfaction. Justice as a motive likewise cannot guarantee that the agreed decision will immediately feel the same to both people.
